events.body:
## Context

`public/charts.html:143` loads `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js` with no version and no SRI, so a future major release can break the Analytics page. Mermaid is already vendored in `public/`.

## What to do

1. Pin an exact version with `integrity` and `crossorigin`, or vendor it like mermaid.
2. Show a message in `charts.js` if `Chart` failed to load.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Version pinned
- [ ] All charts render
- [ ] A readable message if the library fails

## How to test locally

```bash
python3 -m http.server -d blt-owasp-metadata/public 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000   # open /charts.html
```
